name: Armageddon
description: Uncheck any number of Conditions. Roll Spirit vs Dexterity against each creature within far range. On each win, the creature takes 1d10 damage for each Condition you unchecked (2d10 for Troubled and Angry) and its current MP is reduced to zero. On each loss, half damage and its current MP is halved.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: For each Condition you unchecked, you may choose one creature to avoid targeting with the spell.
